name: Robert Mack
source: Robert works as a head waiter in a prestigious restaurant, an achievement which he's proud of. His job's not his passion, though, but a means to pay the bills and enjoy the kind of life he wants. Right now, he's interested in partying and going out, but he would probably like to get a girlfriend, too...
